articles.title: USDA issues alert for biscuit and sausage gravy products because of Listeria risk
articles.description: The USDA’s Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS) is issuing a public health alert for ready-to-eat meat products containing FDA-regulated biscuits that may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.  Additional downstream products may be identified as this ingredient recall progresses.
